preconditions.description: The number of forbidden prefix products n must be non-negative and less than m, and m must be at most 200,000.
The length of the forbidden list must match the number of forbidden prefix products n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in forbidden)
preconditions.description: All elements in the forbidden list must be distinct integers between 0 and m - 1.

postconditions.description: The length of the output sequence must match the printed length k.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in sequence)
postconditions.description: All elements in the output sequence must be integers between 0 and m - 1.
All prefix products of the sequence modulo m must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(x not in forbidden for x in prefix_products)
postconditions.description: No prefix product modulo m must appear in the forbidden list.
The length of the sequence must be maximized given the constraints.
